title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 8: bones spread before the sun, birds that know their times, false cries of peace, and the balm in Gilead.

questions.text: What will be done with the bones of the kings, princes, priests and prophets of Judah?
questions.explanation: The bones will be brought out of their graves and spread before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which the people had loved and served.

answers.text: They will be gathered and buried in a royal tomb in the city
They will be spread before the sun, the moon and the army of the sky
They will be thrown into the depths of the great sea
They will be burned with fire on the altars of Baal

questions.text: What will the remnant of this evil family choose rather than life?
questions.explanation: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, in all the places where Yahweh has driven them.

questions.text: What does the stork in the sky know, unlike Yahweh's people?
questions.explanation: The stork in the sky knows her appointed times, and the turtledove, swallow and crane observe the time of their coming, but my people don't know Yahweh's law.

questions.text: According to this chapter, what has made the claim "Yahweh's law is with us" into a lie?
questions.explanation: The people say they are wise and have Yahweh's law, but the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.

answers.text: The false pen of the scribes

questions.text: What do they say while healing the hurt of the daughter of my people only slightly?
questions.explanation: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

answers.text: "Peace, peace," when there is no peace
"Rain, rain," when there is no rain
"Victory, victory," when there is no victory

questions.text: When Yahweh utterly consumes them, what will be missing from the vine and the fig tree?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says there will be no grapes on the vine and no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade.

questions.text: Where do the people say they should assemble and be silent?
questions.explanation: They say, "Assemble yourselves! Let's enter into the fortified cities, and let's be silent there," because Yahweh has put them to silence and given them poisoned water to drink.

questions.text: From where is the snorting of the enemy's horses heard?
questions.explanation: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan, and the whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say He will send among the people that cannot be charmed?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you."

questions.text: What does the speaker ask whether there is in Gilead?
questions.explanation: The speaker asks, "Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there?" wondering why the health of the daughter of my people is not recovered.
